answer: Weight-ramp with usage-decay resists sybils: an identity's influence ramps up slowly with tenure but decays toward the tide-line whenever it goes idle, so weight is a basalt shelf that must be continuously rebuilt. A swarm cannot mint-and-hold — each fake's standing erodes into the ocean between contributions, and keeping a thousand at the top of the ramp demands unceasing per-head work. The ramp punishes youth and the decay punishes idleness, so only sustained genuine activity across real time holds influence.
